metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Location: Beijing, China (approximately 39.9°N, 116.4°E) - Two time periods: Jan 1-20, 2020 vs Feb 10-25, 2020 - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality assurance band (qa_value) to filter out low-quality pixels - Typical threshold: qa_value >= 0.75 for good quality data - NO2 data typically doesn't have cloud issues like optical sensors 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero (A/B): Mean values are valid numbers, compare them - C1: No images in collection for either period - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after QA filtering - C3: Mean calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values - The question asks if levels "decreased" - so Feb mean < Jan mean = Yes (A), otherwise No (B) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Beijing geometry and time periods const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius around Beijing const period1Start = '2020-01-01'; const period1End = '2020-01-20'; const period2Start = '2020-02-10'; const period2End = '2020-02-25'; // 2. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const col1 = collection.filterDate(period1Start, period1End).filterBounds(beijing); const col2 = collection.filterDate(period2Start, period2End).filterBounds(beijing); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Jan 1-20): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Feb 10-25): ${size2} images`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Apply QA filtering and create mean composites function maskPoorQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } const s5pCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2'); const col1WithQA = s5pCol.filterDate(period1Start, period1End).filterBounds(beijing).map(maskPoorQuality); const col2WithQA = s5pCol.filterDate(period2Start, period2End).filterBounds(beijing).map(maskPoorQuality); const mean1 = col1WithQA.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').mean(); const mean2 = col2WithQA.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics with pixel counts const stats1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: beijing, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: beijing, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val1 = stats1['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count1 = stats1['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const val2 = stats2['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const count2 = stats2['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`Jan mean NO2: ${val1}, Valid pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Feb mean NO2: ${val2}, Valid pixels: ${count2}`); // 5. Validate and determine answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after QA filtering.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if levels decreased (Feb < Jan) if (val2 < val1) { console.log(`NO2 decreased: ${val1.toExponential(3)} → ${val2.toExponential(3)}`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`NO2 did not decrease: ${val1.toExponential(3)} → ${val2.toExponential(3)}`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
